unit: WF5 ingress resolveTestFlag predicate and the digest isTestMatter predicate

source_qa_workflow.name: QA - WF5 Conflict Notice Digest Sections

description: The word testing appears mid sentence, not a marker.
why_it_exists: On 2026-08-23 a synthetic matter was only detected as TEST because the model happened to emit a risk flag saying so. The model titled it "Parked vehicle damage - Perth car park (hit and run) - 17 Aug 2026" with no test marker at all, so one unlucky generation would have counted a synthetic matter as live legal work in the only daily report the owner reads. Fix 1 moved the decision to raw ingress text plus an explicit internal flag, and made it deliberately refuse to fire on ordinary legal English. Case T8 fixes the asymmetry threshold: mislabelling a live matter as test hides real legal work, so the predicate fires only on a leading TEST ONLY / DO NOT USE marker or an explicit internal flag.

ingress.raw_text: The builder is testing the drainage and I want to know my options.

input.note: facts_json.test_data_only is the persisted result of resolveTestFlag(ingress); the digest predicate isTestMatter() then reads matter_id, title, facts_json and risk_flags_json only.

assertions: the flag persisted into facts_json survives classification and the digest predicate isTestMatter() returns false
the decision does not depend on any wording the model chose for the title or the risk flags
target_unresolved_reason: Half of the expect is resolveTestFlag(ingress), a WF5 ingress predicate that does not exist: grep finds no resolveTestFlag in any of .raw/wf{1,2,3,4,5,9}.json or in any of the 59 extracted units. Binding to Build Daily Digest would silently drop that half. The isTestMatter half is covered by wf5-digest-is-test-matter-predicate. See harness/FINDINGS.md.
